description: A `shell` tool's `params.allowed_commands: {from: input.cmds}` is rejected at compile time, before the orchestration ever runs, on both engines -- a by-reference value for a security-sensitive param is never honoured, since it can carry runtime content (`core/compiler.py::_check_security_sensitive_param_leaf`; `electricity-compiler/src/compile/params.rs`'s own compile-time mirror).
